parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
>For hybrid cloud scenarios only, you can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the hybrid cloud clusters.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **5**, which indicates **5** entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.
